requirement: A WordPress live site whose own housekeeping moves rows while it is read (auto-drafts, cron, transients, edit locks, per-user admin settings, plugin queues) still syncs; a live auto-draft never reaches the copy; a sync that stops as busy names the tables and option/meta names that kept changing, never their values

oracle.invariant: S1: wp-admin activity during the read is not busy and done in two reads; a real post/option edit that keeps landing answers LIVE_BUSY naming wp_options (blogname) and wp_posts without values; one extra read only for housekeeping-looking names; live auto-drafts stay off the copy until published
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
